title: Scandinavian UFOs come down only in water

tellings.quote:
and it is important it is not a single
object has crashed on land in Sweden or
Norway

plain: In 1946, when many strange objects were reported over Sweden and Norway, not a single one is said to have crashed on land: the ones that came down all went into water. A Swedish UFO researcher named Clas Svahn points this out, stressing that it is important, while summing up the cases he has studied. The pattern, if real, would suggest the objects behaved in a deliberate way rather than falling at random.
